title: CEMC Pascal, Cayley and Fermat exams
text:
The CEMC Pascal, Cayley and Fermat Contests are annual mathematics competitions run by the Centre for Education in Mathematics and Computing (CEMC) at the University of Waterloo.

Target Grades & Eligibility

• Pascal Contest: Grade 9 (or equivalent) • Cayley Contest: Grade 10 (or equivalent) • Fermat Contest: Grade 11 (or equivalent) • Rule: A student may only write one of these three contests per school year
